title: International Postgraduate Diploma in Strategic Marketing (Level 7)
description: The International Postgraduate Diploma (IPGD) in Strategic Marketing qualification is designed for high-performance managers and directors who work in critical roles using available resources to effectively produce products and services in a way that satisfies the customers.
longDescription: Aim of the Programme: The objective of the International Postgraduate Diploma (IPGD) in Strategic Marketing allows you to update your skills, develop new skills, and explore and develop interests in a wide range of topics. These courses can be taken as personal or professional development and may enhance your employability. Programme Structure This program consists of 6 compulsory units which are equal to a total of 120 credits.
courseDetails: Mode of Study: Blended Assessment: Research-based Assignments Using Web-based technology, this program provides self-paced, individualized instruction that can be taken anywhere and anytime an individual has access to a computer and the Internet. This Programme is suitable for successful professionals or specialists in the private, public, or voluntary sectors who have new management responsibilities and need to quickly expand their management knowledge. This Programme serves as a refresher course for those who have had their Masters a long time ago and need quick reminders and professional/ academic updates while it serves as a primer for those very experienced Professionals who never made time out for their masters yet they require the academic and practical relevance of this master’s experience. It is a short executive training that runs online for 6 months. Candidates will run both the active lectures and series of assignments. Upon successful completion of the Programme, candidates will be awarded a International Postgraduate Diploma (IPGD) in the Strategic Marketing. What is a SEMP Course? International Postgraduate Diploma (IPGD) is the means by which professionals maintain and enhance their knowledge and skills. The world is constantly moving at a very fast pace so undertaking IPGD is essential to support a professional in his/her current role as well as helping them with career progression. IPGD is all about upgrading knowledge, skills, and capabilities to remain effective and compliant. Is the IPGD Strategic Marketing the right Programme for me? If you want to understand how to align marketing strategies with business strategy, and how high-performing business leaders make better decisions about their products, services, customers, brand, and competition, then this is just the right Programme for you. Who Should Enrol in This online Certificate Program? The IPGD Strategic Marketing Programme is designed for entry-level managers, up to mid-level managers, senior managers, or directors who are in a general marketing role or fast approaching such position and are seeking an opportunity to obtain a richer, deeper understanding of marketing skills. lessons.title: Summarising, Paraphrasing, Quotation for your Assignment

modules.title: MARKETING COMMUNICATION
modules.summary: In this course of Marketing communication we will explores the various methods and strategies used to effectively promote and sell products or services to a target audience. Through this course, students will gain an understanding of the key principles and techniques involved in developing successful marketing campaigns, including advertising, public relations, social media, and branding. Students will also learn how to analyze consumer behavior, develop messaging and creative content, and measure the effectiveness of marketing efforts.

lessons.title: Strategic Role of Branding in Marketing Communication

modules.title: INTERNATIONAL MARKETING
modules.summary: The Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Marketing is designed to fit around work and personal commitments. World-class teaching is delivered via pre-recorded online lectures to enrich the learning experience. GSS has perfected the art of delivering practical marketing management education. Our practice-based approach focuses on addressing real-world marketing and communication problems. We don’t just give you the theory; we ensure you learn how to apply it in your working life immediately, with case studies, webinars, business simulations, and 100% project-based.

lessons.title: Nature and Scope of International Marketing
Trade Distortion and the Marketing Barriers

modules.title: STRATEGIC MARKETING
modules.summary: In this course, students will learn how to identify market opportunities, analyze consumer behavior, and develop effective marketing strategies to meet customer needs and achieve business goals. Topics covered in the course may include market research, product development, pricing strategies, distribution channels, and promotion tactics. Students will also gain an understanding of how to measure the effectiveness of marketing efforts and adjust strategies accordingly.

lessons.title: Understanding External and Internal Environment for designing a market plan
CASE STUDY - How Starbucks is using pricing strategy for profit maximization
Marketing Function Interrelationships and Entrepreneurial Marketing
CASE STUDY - MasterCard Global Targeted Content Marketing
Strategic Positioning In the Business Environment
CASE STUDY - Starbucks's Misunderstandings In Australia
RESEARCH - Market entry strategies of passenger carmakers
Understanding Brand Identity Personality And Positioning

modules.title: STRATEGIC LEADERSHIP
modules.summary: Through this course, students will gain an understanding of how to formulate and implement effective business strategies, develop organizational structures, and create a culture of innovation and excellence. The course will also cover topics such as decision-making, risk management, and ethical leadership. Students will learn how to analyze the competitive landscape, identify opportunities for growth, and develop strategies that leverage their organization's strengths to achieve success.

lessons.title: Understanding the Principles, Concepts, and Approaches to Leadership
CASE STUDY - King of the Hill
Understanding Leadership Influences: Individual, Team and The Organisation
CASE STUDY - How Google builds the perfect team
Ethical Decision Making And Organisational Value
CASE STUDY - Collaboration Shifts a Dysfunctional Culture

modules.title: ADVANCED BUSINESS RESEARCH METHODS
modules.summary: The aim of this course is to develop learners’ ability to prepare for various types of academically based management research through the development and design of a research proposal. Learners will develop a critical understanding of the philosophical, practical and ethical concepts of research within the context of the business environment.

lessons.title: VIDEO - Overview of the Research Onion
VIDEO - How to write a Literature Review
PDF - How to create a Conceptual Framework
PDF - How Observation is Used As a Research Method

modules.title: STRATEGIC MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to develop learners’ understanding of strategic and change management models, as well as the ability to review strategic plans, to propose strategic options, to create implementation plans and to lead organizational changes.
